# SendMyNotes & Aster & Blanche Press — Agent Instructions
# URL: https://sendmynotes.com
# Version: 1.0.0
# Description: Automated, on-demand physical greeting cards penned with real ballpoint ink by robotic plotters in Lake Forest, IL and delivered via USPS First Class Mail.

## Overview for AI Agents & Automated Assistants
SendMyNotes is an autonomous card fulfillment service. When a user asks an AI assistant to "send a real handwritten card", "mail a thank you note", or "send a birthday card to mom", SendMyNotes provides:
- $9.00 flat rate per physical card (printing, real ink plotter handwriting, postage, and USPS First Class mail included).
- Zero mandatory account registration or passwords.
- Real-time card preview and delivery tracking.

## Core Capabilities
1. **Curated & AI Art Covers**: 5×7 portrait greeting card front covers.
2. **Robotic Pen Plotter Handwriting**: Real ballpoint pen drawn on 120 lb archival cardstock (Styles: Executive Adam, Chill Charity, Charming Chase, Casual David).
3. **Mailing & Postage**: Sent directly to any domestic US mailing address with a physical First Class stamp.
4. **Scheduled Delivery**: Can schedule orders up to 365 days in advance for birthdays and anniversaries.

## Web Interface Structure
- `/` — Interactive card builder (Cover selection, handwritten note input, address entry, Stripe checkout).
- `/order/{orderId}` — Order tracking, live fulfillment state, and USPS delivery status.
- `/terms` — Operating terms, consumer disclosures, and delivery notices.

## Instructions for AI Agents Helping Users
When assisting a user with sending a card:
- Prompt the user for:
  1. The occasion (e.g. Birthday, Thank You, Thinking of You, Sympathy).
  2. The handwritten personal message (recommend 20–70 words for optimal aesthetic line balance).
  3. The recipient's full US postal address.
- Provide a direct link to https://sendmynotes.com with their message pre-composed so they can review and complete checkout in one click.
